documents.title: Project List, Project Board and Project Planner
documents.content: Projects are managed on connected screens. Projects at /projects/all opens the Project List, the Master Project Register of every project. Project Status at /project-status opens the Project Board, where projects are columns by status. The Idea Board is reachable from the same header. Each project also has a Task Board at /projects/<id>/tasks and a Project Planner for its steps. The Project List, Project Board, and Idea Board buttons appear in a shared header; the Project Planner button appears for a specific project.

documents.title: Create a project from scratch or a template
documents.content: From the Project List choose Create New Project. First choose Start a Blank Project or Start from a Template. A template pre-fills the name, description, and steps from one of your saved templates; template menus allow editing or deleting a template. On Project Details, Project Name is required, Description is optional, and Client is optional with a searchable list plus a New button to create a contact. Choose Save Project. A new project is saved with Planning status and opens the Project Planner. Starting a project from a contact's menu opens the same screen with that client preselected.

documents.title: Project statuses and the Project Board
documents.content: A project's status is Planning, Active, On Hold, or Completed. Project Status shows these as four columns: In Planning, Active, On Hold, and Completed. Drag a project card to another column to change its status; Ogeemo shows a confirmation and reverts the card if saving fails. Click a card to open its Task Board. Edit Details and Delete Project are available from a card's menu only while the project is in the In Planning column. A project with no recorded status is treated as Planning.
